message.dust.ancient.learned: You have deciphered an ancient glyph: %s
message.dust.ancient.already_transcribed: You have already transcribed this glyph
message.dust.ancient.crumbled: The ancient writing crumbles to dust...
tooltip.dust.parchment: Use on a glyph stone to transcribe it
container.dust.decipher.lost: You failed to decipher the glyphs
item.dust.shared_research_guide.author: Notes of %s
tooltip.dust.research_notes: Carry it to record what you observe. Sneak + right-click to open
tooltip.dust.shared_research_guide: A copy of someone's research. Sneak + right-click to read
research.dust.drops.unknown_block: Break one to learn what it drops
research.dust.drops.unknown_mob: Defeat one to learn what it drops
research.dust.sources.unknown: Not yet seen coming from anything
research.dust.research.unknown: Its magical composition is not yet understood. Burning it with a Magical Flint and Steel would show the colour of its dust.
research.dust.research.unread: What elements it holds is not known. The Elemental Examiner would show it.
dust.phase.gaseous.note: caught in a glass bottle, or it hisses away in a puff of its colour.
dust.phase.aqueous.note: caught in a bowl, or it bubbles away in its colour.
dust.phase.amorphous.note: caught on paper, or it burns away in fire of its colour, leaving alchemical soot.
dust.phase.crystalline.note: it stays behind as it is, needing nothing to catch it.
dust.element_tester.no_dust: %s holds no dust the crystals can read
dust.separation.empty: Put something on the scroll first
dust.separation.outputs: Take the last separation's results first
dust.separation.unsplittable: Nothing in this can be separated: it needs at least two solid elements
dust.evaporation.running: It's already going: stir the pot
dust.evaporation.empty: Put something in the pot first
dust.evaporation.nothing: Nothing in this would boil off: it needs a gaseous or aqueous element
dust.evaporation.no_solids: Nothing would be left: it needs a solid element too
dust.research_input.block: Blocks have to be crushed to pebbles first
dust.distillation.empty: Put something in the flask first
dust.distillation.nothing: Nothing in this can be distilled: it needs at least two elements, one gaseous or aqueous
dust.transformation.empty: Put a compound or Alchemical Dust on the scroll first
dust.transformation.nothing: Only alchemical compounds and Alchemical Dust can be transformed
dust.transformation.single: It has to be a compound of a single element
dust.transformation.unknown: You haven't discovered the element in this compound yet
dust.transformation.no_crystal: It's already dust: put an inert crystal or nether quartz on the pad to make a crystal of it
dust.combination.empty: Put Alchemical Dust on both pads first
dust.combination.not_solid: Only solid (crystalline or amorphous) dusts combine here: gaseous or aqueous ones go to the Mixing Table
dust.combination.no_element: These two don't make an element together
dust.mixing.running: It's already going: stir the pot
dust.mixing.empty: Put Alchemical Dust on both pads first
dust.mixing.no_fluid: At least one dust has to be gaseous or aqueous: two solids go to the Combination Table
dust.mixing.no_element: These two don't make an element together
spell.dust.effect.fire.block: Lights the block: a campfire or candle, or fire against it. An item with dust in it there burns in its colour.
spell.dust.effect.water.block: Waterlogs the block, or places a water source against it.
spell.dust.effect.earth.block: Raises a dirt block in the nearest open space.
spell.dust.effect.earth.entity: Drops a pointed dripstone on it from above.
spell.dust.effect.order.self: Dispels harmful effects and lifts curses from held items.
spell.dust.effect.order.block: Sorts a container's items by name.
spell.dust.effect.order.entity: Calms it: it forgets its anger and won't pick a target for a while.
spell.dust.effect.chaos.self: Rage: strength, speed and stepping up blocks, with hunger, mining fatigue and nausea.
spell.dust.effect.chaos.entity: Turns it against the caster as if attacked; shuffles a player's inventory.
spell.dust.effect.energy.self: Drains energy from what you hit, returning a little mana.
spell.dust.effect.energy.entity: Builds charge; at 100 stacks it bursts in a damaging shockwave.
spell.dust.effect.explosion.self: A flare: a firework boost while gliding, otherwise a burst high in the sky.
spell.dust.effect.ice.self: Cooling: puts out fire and scorch.
spell.dust.effect.ice.block: Freezes water; turns lava to obsidian.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.self: Life leech on what you damage.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.block: Corrupts the block; corruption spreads until purified.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.entity: Silences it: no spells, shields, potions or teleporting.
spell.dust.effect.stone.block: Hardens loose blocks: gravel to stone, sand to sandstone, concrete powder to concrete.
spell.dust.effect.mud.self: Sure footing: the ground and water don't slow you.
spell.dust.effect.air.block: Makes the block fall if there's air beneath it.
spell.dust.effect.vacuum.self: Pulls nearby creatures and items towards you.
spell.dust.effect.vacuum.entity: Pulls nearby mobs together around it.
spell.dust.effect.motion.block: Turns the block into a path, if it has one.
spell.dust.effect.motion.entity: Speed, even on mounts, minecarts and elytra.
spell.dust.effect.life.block: Revives dead blocks: dead coral, dead bushes into saplings.
spell.dust.effect.life.entity: Revives fallen pets' ghosts; cures undead creatures.
spell.dust.effect.death.self: Immune to withering, drowning and hunger.
spell.dust.effect.death.block: Kills living blocks: saplings to dead bushes, coral to dead coral.
spell.dust.effect.death.entity: Kills anything under 10% health, bosses too; heals the undead instead.
spell.dust.effect.metal.block: Ores drop extra; other blocks may drop a metal nugget.
spell.dust.effect.metal.entity: Bleeding, which won't stop on its own.
spell.dust.effect.tool.self: Equips the right tool for what you're breaking.
spell.dust.effect.tool.block: The block can be broken with a tool one tier lower.
spell.dust.effect.tool.entity: Lets it pick up items, armour and weapons.
spell.dust.effect.light.block: Places a coloured light you can walk through.
spell.dust.effect.darkness.block: Makes the block see-through for a while.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.self: Shares your effects with friends around you.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.block: Spreads the block's growth (grass, mycelium, nylium) around it.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.entity: Spreads its effects to the mobs around it.
spell.dust.effect.lightning.block: Draws lightning: lightning spells home in on it.
spell.dust.effect.lightning.entity: Lightning rod: more lightning damage, and lightning spells home in on it.
spell.dust.effect.flight.block: The block floats, and can be punched along.
spell.dust.effect.change.self: Harmful effects are half as strong.
spell.dust.effect.change.block: Transmutes the block within its family: stairs, slab, wall, plate, button.
spell.dust.effect.change.entity: Turns it into a baby, or a baby into an adult.
spell.dust.effect.slime.self: Slippery footing, as if on ice.
spell.dust.effect.spirit.entity: Ghost form: it can't act or be hurt.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.self: Stores mana that bursts into healing when you're hurt badly.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.block: Turns a plant into its seeds.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.entity: Turns it into its breeding item.
spell.dust.effect.fungus.self: Immune to poison, mining fatigue and slowness.
spell.dust.effect.fungus.entity: Turns it into a companion that attacks nearby enemies.
spell.dust.effect.armor.block: Wards the block: as tough as obsidian, safe from withers and dragons.
spell.dust.effect.protection.block: Places warded glass that stops mobs but lets players through.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.self: Holds more mana and dust for a while.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.block: Crystallises sand into glass, amethyst into tinted glass.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.entity: Kinetic damage that splinters into the mobs around it.
spell.dust.effect.gem.self: Reflects arrows back at the archer.
spell.dust.effect.gem.block: Compresses the block: coal into diamond, raw ore into ore. It may crumble.
spell.dust.effect.gem.entity: Encases it in crystal; breaking out leaves it vulnerable.
spell.dust.effect.fracture.self: Crushes the items in hand: ore to raw ore, ingots to nuggets.
spell.dust.effect.fracture.block: Crumbles the block: stone to gravel, gravel to flint.
spell.dust.effect.creature.self: Pack tactics: double damage against what your allies fight.
spell.dust.effect.creature.block: Animates the block to scurry around.
spell.dust.effect.creature.entity: Marked: it takes double damage, and glows.
spell.dust.effect.flesh.block: Leaves a pool of blight that sickens whoever walks on it.
spell.dust.effect.flesh.entity: It drops extra leather, meat and flesh.
spell.dust.effect.plants.self: Plants the seed in your hand.
spell.dust.effect.plants.block: Grows a flower or plant there.
spell.dust.effect.plants.entity: Tangled: slowed, and thorns hurt it as it moves.
spell.dust.effect.trees.entity: Builds roots; at 100 stacks a tree grows where it stands.
spell.dust.effect.void.self: A winged ender chest appears beside you.
spell.dust.effect.void.block: Opens a rift that swallows what touches it.
spell.dust.effect.soul.self: Leaves a ghost of you as a temporary respawn that keeps your inventory.
spell.dust.effect.soul.block: The block won't drop when broken, and returns later.
spell.dust.effect.soul.entity: Pulls its soul out: it must find its body before the effect ends.
spell.dust.effect.magic.block: Amplifies the chunk's aura at the block.
spell.dust.effect.warp.self: Warps you to a marked place, or your respawn point.
spell.dust.effect.warp.block: Warps the block or items to a marked place.
spell.dust.effect.warp.entity: Warps it to a marked place, or your respawn point.
spell.dust.effect.sound.block: Plays a note block's sound for the block.
dust.spell.no_target: There's nothing there for the spell
dust.magic.exhausted: A heavy weariness settles over you. Whatever that dust drew from you, you need to sleep it off.
dust.magic.dream: You dreamed of motes of colour drifting through the dark... and wake with a strange new power stirring within you.
dust.pylon.no_element: Set an element crystal on the Spell Pylon to begin a spell
dust.pylon.has_element: This Spell Pylon already has its element
dust.pylon.info: %s spell: level %s (%s/%s), %s level(s) to spend; blessing %s, corruption %s
dust.pylon.recorded: The spell is written onto the scroll
dust.pylon.cant_record: The spell needs an element and a Shape Pylon first
dust.pylon.not_connected: This pylon isn't part of a spell: place it where a Spell Pylon shows a ghost
dust.pylon.shape_fixed: The shape is set once modifier pylons follow it
dust.pylon.no_shapes: You don't know any spell shapes yet
dust.pylon.break_on: Spell Break: powered, the spell carries on
dust.pylon.break_off: Spell Break: unpowered, the spell ends here
dust.pylon.nothing: Nothing more could be drawn out here
dust.pylon.upgrade_full: Every upgrade node on this pylon is filled
dust.pylon.upgrade_none: This pylon has no upgrade nodes
dust.pylon.upgrade_no_level: The spell has no levels to spend
research.dust.note.default.blocks: %s. Its nature may be revealed by further study.
research.dust.note.default.creatures: %s. A living creature, shaped by the aura it lives in.
research.dust.note.default.bosses: %s. A being of immense power, steeped in dust.
research.dust.note.default.effects: %s. A change worked on a living body by the flow of dust.
research.dust.note.element_tester: The first dust recipe: one item each of pure red, green, blue, white and black dust, with a crafting table, in any arrangement (a Magical Flint and Steel's flame shows which items are pure). Set crystals on it to make it an Elemental Examiner: an item on its plate lights a gauge to each crystal, one line per 10% of that crystal's element in it. The crystal sparkles when the item is all its element.
research.dust.note.default.elements.prim: %s: one of the five primal dusts everything is made of.
research.dust.note.default.enchantments: %s. Dust bound into an object, lending it a lasting power.
research.minecraft.note.stone: The bones of the world. Dust settles deep within it over countless ages.
research.minecraft.note.zombie: A body without a spirit, kept moving by stale aura. Sunlight burns it away.
research.minecraft.note.cow: A gentle grazer. Its milk soothes lingering effects.
research.dust.note.flower_windwheel: Its petals turn even in still air, as if pushed by the aura itself.
effect.dust.effect_scorch.description: Burns entity until it reaches 100, at which point it explodes.
death.attack.kinetic: %s was struck down by a magical blow
death.attack.scorch.player: %s was scorched to death trying to out run %s
effect.dust.effect_magnet.description: Magnetizes items, xp, and dust to the player.
